items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: Like, now Jimmy Noon, now he started down there with Sam Ross and Churro, Sam Bo.

ctx.x: I went to the old fella, old fella, and took one lesson with him with the clan that. And I went back no more.
Well, that's a long time though.

Of course, a lot of them fellas didn't know them fellas back up in there. No, that's right. Like, now Jimmy Noon, now he started down there with Sam Ross and Churro, Sam Bo. Sam Bo, yeah. Used to play trombone there. That's where he started.
